children: Treasury yields have climbed a little further after the Treasury Department reported that it had bought $5.2 billion of longer-term bonds at its afternoon buyback operation-less than the maximum amount of $6 billion that it was willing to buy.

The government received more than $10 billion of offers by par value, but its guidelines state that it is only supposed to purchase Treasurys at prevailing market prices. The yield on the 10-year Treasury note was recently 4.946%, according to Tradeweb, up from 4.938% before the buyback results were announced and 4.836% Wednesday.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
